name: The Sixth Bell
objective: Hang the six bells in the chapel's ring and take the Director's place at the rope. Tonight is the chosen hour.
intro: Six bells. Six stands. The heart of ice turns in the air like a patient animal, watching.
dialogue: The Midnight Ringer: "Two soft, one loud, rest. And whatever hears you — sing like you mean it."
Hunter Sigrun: "If this goes wrong, it's on your head. Mine would have been heavier."
lore_discovery: The sixth bell is mounted. The Winter Chorus can now be rung at the player's hand. Far above, the glacier begins — very slowly — to glow.
